title: Chidushei Agadot on Sanhedrin
enDesc: Written by Rabbi Shmuel Eliezer Edels, the Maharsha (1555 – 1631, Poland), Chidushei Aggadot is a commentary on the aggadic (non-legal) portions of the Talmud. The commentary reflects the author’s vast knowledge of philosophy and Kabbalah.
heDesc: פירוש על כל האגדות שבתלמוד בבלי.
